name: house
doc: A village house, store, or workshop, outside only (design/systems.md, Village houses): the game asks for a type, a stage of its owner's upgrades (construction, basic, deluxe, premium), a season, a household (solo, family, or extended, which sizes the lot), and a lot shape, with the local wind; build makes the building on its lot with its sign, yard, and moving parts, and the animator sways, spins, smokes, flickers, and opens the door when the game says.

params.name: type
params.doc: A type: one entry from config/house_types/.

params.name: palette
params.doc: A colour scheme from config/house_palettes/, mixed over the type's colours part by part: a player's colour or a village's theme (natural keeps the type's own).

params.name: theme
params.doc: The village's theme from config/village_themes/: its roofs, plan, walls, windows, foundation, ornaments, colours, and fires (heartland keeps the type's own).

params.name: stage
params.doc: How far its owner has come, or a ruin (a premium house fallen to wreck: roofless, broken, overgrown). Every stage stands on the same footprint.

params.name: household
params.doc: Who lives or works there, which sets the lot's size: solo, family, or extended (several generations).

params.name: footprint
params.doc: The type's usual lot shape (wide, deep, round, long, or broad) or its other one.

params.name: seed
params.doc: Which of the distinct buildings per type, stage, and season (the runtime caps how many by quality).

params.name: detail
params.doc: Level of detail; the runtime picks it from distance and quality.

params.name: wind_heading
params.doc: Toward which the wind blows, from +Z toward +X.

params.name: door_time
params.doc: Seconds since the door opened; negative while it is shut. The game starts it when someone comes to the door (foundry_house_start_door); it opens, stays for a visit, and closes.
